notes: Mathlib proof A19_2_main: Set.Infinite {n | forall k, 2^k < n -> Squarefree (n - 2^k)}, via A19_exists (s >= 20 gives such n with s < n <= 2^(9702 s)): candidates n = c + 4Rj, R = odd primorial(2310 s), c = 3 mod 4, R | c; union bound over k < 9702 s and primes p > 2310 s with sum 1/p^2 <= 480/(2310^2 (s-1)) via blocks coprime to 2310; Bertrand for n > s.
